## Episode Thesis

This Di-style episode came six days before the Swedish election. It covered a survey of 53 business leaders and an interview with Mikael Wolf, investor and former Swedbank CEO. Wolf criticised the proposed bank tax, which he expects to be passed on to customers and to weaken banks' ability to absorb credit losses, and he called exit and billionaire taxes counterproductive; he preferred cutting the mortgage interest deduction. The discussion was political and macro-focused, with no buy or sell views on individual stocks, and a cautious mood about policy uncertainty.
